Code blocks use 4-space indentation

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import CodeBlockStyle, ConversionOptions, convert

def main() -> None:
    html = "<pre><code>print('hello')</code></pre>"
    options = ConversionOptions(code_block_style=CodeBlockStyle("Indented"))
    result = convert(html, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
